incident.failed_stage: Validate candidate root boot and protected data

directive.name: FREEZE_AND_EVIDENCE_CURRENT_CHECKPOINT
directive.requirement: Capture hashes and current PART4-R2/Maestro state, P3/P5/root context, the failed run, and exact SFDISK blocker before any mutation.

directive.name: AUTHORIZED_MINIMAL_SFDISK_REMEDIATION
directive.requirement: Resolve sfdisk by the least-impact valid change. Prefer an existing canonical absolute path if present; otherwise install the official Debian fdisk package at the repository candidate version under governed noninteractive sudo. Record source/version/dependencies and make no cross-domain or canonical mutation.

directive.name: VALIDATE_REMEDIATION
directive.requirement: Verify command path, version, functional read-only sfdisk test, provenance, reproducibility evidence, and fresh PROYECTOS manifest equivalence.

directive.name: NON_REGRESSION_AND_REVERSIBILITY
directive.requirement: Preserve the pre-change checkpoint, prove applicable rollback/reversibility, verify no PART4-R2 protected state or PROYECTOS regression, and resume idempotently without replaying migration or already certified operations.

directive.name: REENTER_CERTIFICATION_AND_RESUME
directive.requirement: Evaluate applicable PUAC.C25-C32 controls, obtain independent G23 and digest-bound G24 for the remediation, then dispatch the existing PART4-R2 final-merge postboot continuation. Do not retire P5 or expand P3 before the existing postboot G23/G24 gates pass.
